_source: New content for pages/game/view.php via src/Controllers/GameController.php. The embed itself is a standalone HTML5 canvas game living at static/games/canerush/index.html (not a WordPress-templated page) - the Controller resolves that relative path against VINTAGESOUL_URI for the iframe src, same local-asset pattern data/content/franchise.json's hero.image already uses.

hero.title: Cane Rush
hero.sub: Dodge the crates, dash past the carts, and race the cane fields for the high score.
